description: The Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission publishes each quarter 'Communications and Multimedia: Facts and Figures', formerly the Pocket Book of Statistics, with editions listed from 2011 to the first quarter of 2026 (released on 3 July 2026). The 13-page edition covers market capitalisation of the sector, penetration rates of fixed broadband per 100 premises, mobile broadband and mobile cellular per 100 inhabitants and pay TV per 100 households, broadband penetration and subscriptions by state, total, mobile and fixed broadband subscriptions, broadband traffic, mobile broadband coverage by state, mobile cellular subscriptions, pay TV and digital signatures; in the first quarter of 2026 there were about 49.6 million broadband subscriptions. Coverage: Malaysia, by state. Format and access: PDF on the MCMC website, free; MCMC publications may be reproduced for non-commercial use with acknowledgement. Caveats: figures are in PDF charts and tables; operator-reported data; definitions noted per chart. Simulation uses: state-level subscription, coverage and traffic inputs for demand models, and exposure of populations by state. Related records: the MCMC consumer surveys give user behaviour and satisfaction, and the ITU indicators give international comparisons.
